thesis: Waiting for motivation is not laziness and not a character flaw: it is a bet that pays immediately and compounds against you, because the act of waiting is what turns an ordinary task into one that requires an unusual state.

metadata.title: Why Waiting for Motivation Keeps You Stuck
title_alternatives: You Are Not Unmotivated. You Are Waiting.
description_lead: Motivation is not the ticket. It is the receipt.

This is an argument, not a pep talk: waiting for motivation is the thing that turns an ordinary task into one that needs an unusual state. We walk through where that loop comes from, what the research actually says, and the one sentence that lowers the cost of starting.
Two numbers this video corrects, with the primary sources on screen: the "66 days to form a habit" figure, and willpower as a draining fuel tank.
metadata.made_for_kids_rationale: Conteúdo para público adulto; não é direcionado a crianças. Campo declarado explicitamente, não deixado em branco.
